اصطبحوا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَحُوا (iṣṭabaḥū) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اُصْطُبِحُوا (uṣṭubiḥū) /usˤ.tˤu.bi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اِصْطَبِحُوا (iṣṭabiḥū) /isˤ.tˤa.bi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
